info.name: NGOConnect API v4.4 (v4.5 SuperAdmin)
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for NGOConnect platform v4.0

Base URL: https://api.ngoconnect.app/api/v1

14 Modules | 80+ Endpoints | 100 Stored Procedures | 47 DB Tables

Authentication: OTP-based login → JWT Bearer token

Setup:
1. Run '01 Auth > Send OTP' with your mobile number
2. Run '01 Auth > Verify OTP' → copy access_token to collection variable
3. All authenticated endpoints use {{access_token}} automatically

request.description: Admin dashboard KPIs (s-admin screen). Returns: { totalMembers, newMembersThisMonth, activeVolunteers, activeRatePct, volunteerHoursMonth, activeProjects, pendingApplications }
Recommended NGOs matched to user interests (s-explore Recommended tab). Returns: [{ orgId, orgName, category, logoUrl, city, state, memberCount, avgRating, latitude, longitude, matchScore }]
Trending active campaigns (s-explore Trending tab). Returns: [{ campaignId, campaignName, orgName, orgLogoUrl, raisedAmount, targetAmount, donorCount, progressPct, endDate, isEmergency }]

Donation KPIs for admin (s-admin-donations screen). Returns: { totalRaisedAllTime, thisMonthRaised, lastMonthRaised, todayRaised, todayTransactionCount, recurringMonthlyAmount, activeRecurringDonors, totalCampaigns, activeCampaigns }

Admin view of volunteer (s-vol-profile screen). Includes reliability score. Returns: { userId, fullName, city, occupation, profilePhoto, totalHours, projectCount, orgCount, reliabilityPct, avgRating, peerRating, noShowCount, excusedCount, complaintCount, roleCode, roleName, statusCode, statusName, joinedAt }

Admin view of member impact (s-member-impact screen). Returns: { userId, fullName, occupation, city, roleName, impactScore, reliabilityPct, totalHours, projectCount, orgCount, badgeCount, noShowCount, complaintCount }
Award a badge to a volunteer (s-vol-profile / s-participants screens). badgeLkpId from LookupType: BADGE_TYPE

Paginated donor list (s-admin-donors screen). Returns: [{ userId, fullName, email, phone, totalDonated, donationCount, lastDonatedAt, isAnonymous, isRecurring }]

Paginated transaction list (s-admin-transactions screen). Returns: [{ transactionId, readableId, donorName, amount, netAmount, campaignName, statusCode, statusName, paymentMethod, createdAt, isAnonymous }]
Admin view of all org community posts (pinned first). SP: Org_GetAdminPosts. v4.4 NEW

Soft-delete a community post (admin). SP: Org_DeletePost. v4.4 NEW
Moderate (hide/unhide) a community post. action: HIDE | UNHIDE. SP: Org_ModeratePost. v4.4 NEW

formdata.description: Select a file from your device. Max 10 MB.

query.description: Allowed: user-documents | user-photos | org-documents | org-logos | certificates

request.description:
Step 1 of 2-step upload flow. Upload a file and receive fileUrl + fileName + fileSizeKb. Pass those values to the entity endpoint (POST /user/documents, PUT /user/profile, etc.).

Allowed modules:
- user-documents: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png
- user-photos: jpg, jpeg, png
- org-documents: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png
- org-logos: jpg, jpeg, png, svg
- certificates: pdf
